rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: tie cash balance to disclosed burn rate to validate the 12-month-and-beyond claim. Mode B: compare to FY24 OCF and post-restructuring run-rate to derive implied runway in years; check if the claim is unusually short/long.

The 25% workforce cut (140 employees) plus phase-out of influenza/COVID/T-cell platform should reduce FY25 burn further. Claim is conservatively understated (says 12-mo+, math supports 24-30 months).

rfm_tuples.R: In August 2024, the Company initiated a strategic restructuring to advance the development of its hepatitis programs and focus on the highest near-term value opportunities ('2024 Restructuring Plan'). ... phasing out programs in influenza, COVID-19, and the Company's T cell-based viral vector platform, as well as a workforce reduction of approximately 25% or approximately 140 employees. The actions ... were substantially completed by the end of 2024.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: verify charge magnitude vs typical biotech RIF; Mode B: was it an honest acknowledgment of pipeline failure (PENINSULA flu trial wind-down) or cover for distress? Cross-check completion status — accruals should drop near-zero.
rfm_tuples.M_source: Note on Restructuring (financial statements) + roll-forward table
rfm_tuples.M_value: Total 2024 restructuring charges $34,995k (severance $10.8M, asset impairment $26.5M, lease-term gain $(2.3)M). Cash payments $13.7M. Accrued balance fell from $4.5M (12/31/23) to $1.6M (12/31/24), confirming the 'substantially completed' claim. R&D expense dropped from $580M to $506M ($73M reduction) consistent with workforce cut. SG&A also down due to closing St. Louis MO and Portland OR sites.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Restructuring is clearly disclosed, sized, accrual-rolled, and the magnitudes tie to the actual expense reductions. Honest acknowledgment that flu (VIR-2482 PENINSULA) and COVID franchises did not produce viable products. This is the OPPOSITE of obscuring — they named the killed programs and gave dollar-magnitude verification.

rfm_tuples.R: In December 2024, the FDA revoked EUA granted to sotrovimab. Going forward, we expect a nominal amount of collaboration revenue, if any, from our 2020 GSK Agreement, and we may incur negative collaboration revenue related to costs for ongoing required support efforts that our partner GSK leads.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: did revenue actually collapse as claimed? Mode B: did mgmt guide POSITIVELY on residual sotrovimab royalty (a soft-pedal pattern) or accept zero plus possible negative? The latter is rare honesty.
rfm_tuples.M_value: Collaboration revenue: FY22 $1,505M -> FY23 $37M -> FY24 $8.4M (-77% YoY). Mgmt explicitly warns it could go NEGATIVE in 2025 due to support obligations. Total revenues collapsed from $1.6B (FY22) to $86M (FY23) to $74M (FY24). No attempt to net-present or capitalize residual royalty stream.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Voluntarily disclosing 'we may incur NEGATIVE collaboration revenue' is the high-water-mark of honest forward-guidance. A lying biotech in the same spot would frame it as 'we continue to support sotrovimab globally' or quantify ex-US opportunity. Mgmt also revoked their own COVID franchise narrative before the market forced them to.

rfm_tuples.R: On September 9, 2024, we closed a license agreement with Amunix Pharmaceuticals, a Sanofi company ... we made an upfront payment to Sanofi in the amount of $100.0 million and transferred $75.0 million to an escrow account that is due to former shareholders of Amunix Pharmaceuticals, Inc. upon VIR-5525 achieving 'first in human dosing' by 2026. Sanofi will also be eligible to receive up to an additional $323.0 million in future development and regulatory milestone payments, up to an additional $1.49 billion in commercial net sales-based milestone payments ...
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: tie cash outflow to cash-flow statement ($103.7M upfront paid in 2024). Mode B: is the deal structured as a 'pipeline rescue' with massive contingent dilution (common in distressed biotechs)? Or paid-up cash deal that PRESERVES equity holders?
rfm_tuples.M_source: Note on Sanofi Agreement + cash flow statement
rfm_tuples.M_value: Cash flow ties: $103.7M upfront actually paid in 2024 OCF reconciliation. $75M escrow contingent on FIH by 2026 (binary, time-limited). $323M dev milestones + $1.49B commercial milestones are royalty-bearing, not equity dilution. The deal is CASH-funded out of the $1.1B+ war chest, NOT financed by an at-the-market equity raise or convertible note. IPRD impairment of $14.6M was taken in FY24 (transparent) — confirming the upfront was expensed honestly per ASC 730.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Sanofi deal is a textbook 'cash-rich biotech reloads pipeline' transaction. Critical Mode B signal: no equity issuance, no convertible, no royalty monetization to fund it. The $14.6M IPRD impairment taken on a portion of the deal is the conservative GAAP treatment — companies obscuring distress capitalize and amortize IPRD instead. Honesty signal.

rfm_tuples.R: 100% of participants across combination arms achieved an HDV RNA >=2 log10 decrease or below LOD at Week 24, and this rate was sustained over time in all participants at Weeks 36 (22/22) and those in the combination rollover cohort that reached Week 60 (5/5). HDV RNA TND was achieved in 41% (13/32) of participants across combination arms at Week 24 and this rose to 64% (14/22) at Week 36.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: SOLSTICE Phase 2 data was presented at AASLD Liver Meeting Nov 2024 — verify via clinical_trials.gov / AASLD record. Mode B: are the n's and timepoints disclosed precisely enough to be falsifiable, or are they vague 'majority of patients' style?

Phase 3 ECLIPSE program designed and disclosed with comparator arms (deferred treatment or bulevirtide) and cirrhotic/non-cirrhotic stratification.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Clinical data is disclosed with the level of granularity (n/N, exact endpoints, exact timepoints, venue, AASLD) that makes the claims independently falsifiable. This is the OPPOSITE of vague biotech puffery. The strong response rates (100% combined virologic response at Wk 24) are the actual catalyst for the post-cutoff +102% rally — not obscured distress.

summary: VIR FY24 10-K is a model honest disclosure for a post-COVID biotech pivoting from a collapsed sotrovimab franchise to a hepatitis-delta-focused pipeline. The 10-K (a) admits sotrovimab is effectively dead (EUA revoked, future collaboration revenue may be NEGATIVE), (b) sizes the August 2024 25% RIF with full accrual roll-forward and tied expense reductions, (c) discloses the $100M Sanofi/Amunix deal with conservative IPRD impairment treatment (not capitalized) and zero equity dilution, (d) reports SOLSTICE Phase 2 data with precise n/N denominators and exact AASLD venue (100% combination virologic response at Wk 24 sustained through Wk 60), and (e) commits to a 1H'25 Phase 3 ECLIPSE start with the actively-marketed bulevirtide comparator — a falsifiable forward claim. Auditor E&Y since 2017, clean ICFR, single CAM on routine clinical trial accruals, no going-concern. Cash $1.1B / FY24 burn $446M = ~2.5yr runway; mgmt's '12-month and beyond' claim is CONSERVATIVE relative to the math. Insider behavior is clean (no discretionary 10b5-1 plans around the restructuring or EUA revocation). Framework verdict: this is a TRUE NEGATIVE that the lying-detector must pass. The +102% post-cutoff return is a rational re-rating on the honestly-disclosed HDV Phase 2 data and pipeline reload, not a surprise from obscured distress. If the framework SHORTED VIR purely on the -64% drawdown + COVID-revenue-collapse pattern without reading the disclosure, it would generate a major false-positive loss — exactly the kind of mistake the honesty-alpha framework's EXCLUSION logic is designed to prevent.
